notes: Move shows to another library: Settings → Plex and your lists → pick the library to move from and the one to move into. AniBox shows which Plex libraries use each folder, lists every show old → new (and why a locked or semi-locked show can't go), moves the ticked ones on the same drive by renaming, then asks Plex to scan the moved folders (never into a library only old-agent Plex libraries use). History → Undo moves them back. Watched marks to Plex: for one Plex TV library, episodes watched in AniBox but not in Plex are marked watched there after a preview; never un-marks; History → Undo un-marks exactly those.
